name: Helon
overview: Helon is identified in Scripture as the father of Eliab, a prominent leader from the tribe of Zebulun. Eliab, son of Helon, is repeatedly noted as the captain and prince over Zebulun's children, responsible for leading the tribe in the wilderness (Numbers 1:9; 2:7; 10:16). His role also included offering peace sacrifices on behalf of his tribe, demonstrating his position of spiritual and communal responsibility (Numbers 7:24, 7:29). These passages highlight Helon's legacy through Eliab's leadership and service within Israel's camp during their journey.
